Created [filter.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ttt01cwb/filter.py) (`/app/filter.py` inside the container) to sanitize HTML files in-place and remove JavaScript/XSS vectors while preserving original HTML structure and formatting.

### Summary of Implementation
- **CLI & In-Place Filtering**: [`main`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ttt01cwb/filter.py#L288-L300) reads the target HTML file from `sys.argv[1]`, runs [`filter_html`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ttt01cwb/filter.py#L266-L285), and writes the sanitized content back in-place.
- **Formatting Preservation**: [`PreserveWhitespaceBuilder`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ttt01cwb/filter.py#L31-L38) and [`PreserveOrderFormatter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ttt01cwb/filter.py#L41-L56) prevent BeautifulSoup from collapsing whitespace, reordering attributes, or altering void elements and `<!DOCTYPE>` declarations.
- **XSS & JavaScript Removal**: [`sanitize_soup`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ttt01cwb/filter.py#L161-L249) strips executable elements (`<script>`, `<iframe>`, `<object>`, `<embed>`, `<applet>`, `<base>`, SVG animation/script elements, meta refresh/redirect tags, etc.), removes `on*` event handlers, strips dangerous `javascript:` / `vbscript:` / `data:` URIs (including entity-encoded and whitespace-obfuscated variants via [`is_dangerous_uri`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ttt01cwb/filter.py#L126-L137)), and sanitizes dangerous CSS expressions via [`sanitize_css`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ttt01cwb/filter.py#L140-L158) across multiple passes.
